name: Doki Doki Emerald Affection
storyline: After one month in the club and graduation only a few months away, MC becomes conflicted about how he feels about the club president, Monika. With a complicated past, and a drive to make Monika happy, will he work up the guts to be with her? Or will life’s problems get in the way? Find out in this Act 1 release of Doki Doki: Emerald Affection!
summary: Doki Doki: Emerald Affection is a modification of the game Doki Doki Literature Club! which focuses on the relationship between the protagonist (MC) and the club president, Monika. After a month in the club and with graduation approaching, the MC begins to question his feelings for Monika. With a complicated past and the desire to make her happy, he faces the dilemma of confessing his feelings or letting life's problems get in the way.
